title: Acne consultation
what: A dermatologist examines your skin, finds out what causes the pimples, and chooses treatment. It is a regular visit with no painful procedures.
why: When pimples do not go away, leave marks, hurt, or affect your life.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 30 minutes; treatment usually shows results in 6 to 12 weeks
tell_doctor: What skin products and medicines you have already tried
All medicines you take, including hormones
Pregnancy or plans for pregnancy. This matters for choosing treatment
Irregular periods, or facial hair growth in women

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: Come without makeup, so the doctor can see your skin.

prepare.title: Products
prepare.text: Take photos of the products you use or bring them.

prepare.title: Do not squeeze
prepare.text: For a few days before the visit, do not squeeze pimples or have any skin procedures.

bring: A list of your skin products and medicines
Test results, if you already had tests
steps: The doctor asks when the pimples started and what helped
The doctor checks your face, and sometimes your back and chest
Treatment and skin care are chosen
The doctor explains how to use the products
feel: At the start of treatment, the skin may get dry, flaky, or red. Tell your doctor
after: Use the products regularly, as your doctor said
Do not expect results right away. It usually takes 6 to 12 weeks
Come to the follow-up visit so the treatment can be adjusted

faq.q: Why did my skin get worse with treatment?
faq.a: In the first weeks, the skin may react with irritation. Do not stop on your own. Tell your doctor, and they will adjust it.

faq.q: Do I need to change my diet?
faq.a: Sometimes the doctor suggests looking at your diet. But regular treatment that the doctor chooses matters most.

reminders.text: Dermatologist visit soon. Come without makeup and bring a list of the products you use.
